    AI Overview
    Hofstra University is located in Hempstead, New York, on Long Island, approximately 25 miles east of Manhattan. The campus address is 900 Fulton Avenue, Hempstead, NY 11550, situated near the Nassau Veterans Memorial Coliseum. It is a suburban campus with easy access to New York City. 
    Key Details About Hofstra's Location: 
    • Location: Hempstead, Long Island, NY.
    • Proximity to NYC: ~25 miles from Manhattan.
    • Address: 900 Fulton Avenue, Hempstead, NY 11550.
    • Campus Setting:
      Suburban.
       
    The university is a major institution on Long Island known for its proximity to both the city and the Atlantic shore.

    AI Overview
    Hofstra University is a respected, mid-tier private university on Long Island known for strong specialized programs, particularly in law, business, and health, rather than top-tier national prestige. It is ranked #183 in National Universities by U.S. News & World Report (2026), recognized as a "Best Value School" (#99), and known for hosting presidential debates. 
    Key Prestige and Academic Factors: 
    • Rankings: Frequently appears in The Princeton Review’s "Best Colleges" and is ranked #183 in 2026 National Universities.
    • Specialized Reputation: Hofstra has strong reputations in specific areas, particularly the
      Zucker School of Medicine (with Northwell Health), the Maurice A. Deane School of Law, and the Frank G. Zarb School of Business.
    • Distinctions: Known for hosting three consecutive presidential debates (2008, 2012, 2016), which boosted its national profile.
    • Location Advantage: Its proximity to New York City offers strong networking and internship opportunities.
    • Academic Programs: Offers roughly 160 undergraduate programs and boasts a 13-spot rise in recent national rankings, along with a top-100 placement for value. 
    While not an Ivy League-level institution, Hofstra is a solid, well-regarded choice, especially for students in the NYC area looking for a mid-sized school with active campus life and reputable professional programs.

      Description

      Hofstra University is a private research university in Hempstead, New York, United States. It originated in 1935 as an extension of New York University and became an independent college in 1939. Wikipedia
      Address: 1000 Hempstead Tpke, Hempstead, NY 11549
      Acceptance rate: 68.1% (2024) IPEDS
      Undergraduate tuition and fees: 55,450 USD (2023 – 24) IPEDS
      Campus: Large suburb, 244 acres (99 ha)
      Mascot: Willie Pride, Kate Pride
      Students: 10,685 (2025)
      Typical SAT scores: Reading and Writing 620-700, Math 610-700 (2023–24) IPEDS
      Application fee: a $70 hofstra.edu
      Colors: Blue, white, and gold;
      President: Susan Poser
      Provost: Charles Riordan
      Established: September 23, 1935; 90 years ago
      Endowment: $955.8 million (2025)
      Phone: (516) 463-6600
